entities.name: Fall of the Berlin Wall
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The opening of the Berlin Wall on November 9, 1989, symbolized the end of the Cold War and the collapse of communist regimes across Eastern Europe. It led to German reunification in 1990 and accelerated the dissolution of the Soviet Union.
